title: Weekday or weekend, with a null check first

blocks.text: Calling a method on `null` throws `NullPointerException`, so a reference that may be `null` is checked first. An early `return` for the bad input keeps the rest of the method flat instead of nesting it inside an `if`.

items: `"Weekend"` for Saturday and Sunday, and `"Weekday"` for Monday to Friday, in any mix of upper and lower case;

blocks.text: Examples: `type("Saturday")` is `"Weekend"`, `type("friday")` is `"Weekday"`, `type("MONDAY")` is `"Weekday"`, `type("Someday")` is `"Invalid day"`, and `type(null)` is `"Invalid input"`.

cases.says: Day names are sorted into weekend, weekday or invalid.
null is "Invalid input", not a NullPointerException.
"sunday" and "MONDAY" are recognised in any case.

concepts: Early returns replace deep nesting and keep each condition flat.
A reference is checked for null before a method is called on it.
